# CANDIDATE: SNIPER_LEVEL_BREAK_STAGE2_TOPKEEPER

**Filed:** 2026-07-16  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** filter_change

## Hypothesis

The SNIPER_LEVEL_BREAK strategy aims to capture breaks of key levels with volume and body confirmation. This parameter refinement seeks to improve edge on J's winner days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) while avoiding losses on loser days by tightening entry conditions (vol_mult, body_min_cents, min_stars) and optimizing exit parameters (premium_stop, TP1, runner, profit lock) to better capture trending moves and cut losses quickly.

## Mechanism

Entry triggers when: volume ≥ 1.1× 20-bar average, candle body ≥ $0.02, quality stars ≥ 2, strike is OTM-2 (strike_offset=2 for puts on bearish days), price breaks above open (require_break_above_open=true) and is within $1.50 of a named level (proximity_dollars=1.5). Exit uses: 6% premium stop (premium_stop_pct=-0.06), 40% TP1 target selling 66.7% of position (tp1_premium_pct=0.4, tp1_qty_fraction=0.667), 300% runner target (runner_target_pct=3.0), and trailing profit lock arms immediately (profit_lock_threshold_pct=0.0) with 8% trailing offset (profit_lock_stop_offset_pct=0.08).
